name: Listening To Secular Music
overview: Scripture calls believers to guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that what they listen to deeply influences their spiritual life (Proverbs 4:23; Mark 4:24). The psalmist exhorts us to praise God in all things, emphasizing worship that honors Him rather than worldly influences (Psalms 150:1). The wisdom literature warns against folly and corruption that come from rejecting God (Psalms 14:1) and encourages understanding and restraint in what we allow into our minds (Proverbs 11:12). Romans 12:2 further instructs believers not to conform to worldly patterns but to be transformed by renewing the mind, highlighting the importance of discerning and aligning our habits, including music choices, with God’s perfect will.
